title: Three names
intro: Üç kişi kendini tanıtıyor. Herkes adını, nereli olduğunu ve nerede yaşadığını söylüyor.
text:
Hello! My name is Deniz. I am from Turkey. I live in Izmir. Izmir is a big city. I am a student. I am not married.

Hello! My name is Ana. I am from Spain. I live in a town in the north. I am a teacher. I am very happy here.

Hello! My name is Tom. I am from Ireland. I am not from Turkey, but I live in Turkey now. My city is Izmir too. Deniz and I meet on Friday.

questions.text: Where is Deniz from?
questions.explain: „I am from Turkey.“ — Deniz Türkiye'den. Spain Ana'nın, Ireland Tom'un ülkesi.

questions.text: Who is a teacher?
questions.explain: „I am a teacher.“ satırı Ana'nın paragrafında. Deniz öğrenci, Tom ne olduğunu söylemiyor.

questions.text: Deniz is married.
questions.explain: „I am not married.“ — „not“ cümleyi olumsuz yapıyor, yani evli değil.

questions.text: Ana lives in a town in the ___.
questions.explain: „I live in a town in the north.“ — kuzeyde bir kasabada.

questions.text: Where does Tom live now?
questions.explain: „I am not from Turkey, but I live in Turkey now.“ — Tom İrlandalı ama Türkiye'de yaşıyor.

title: Are you a student here?
intro: Mert ile Lena ilk kez tanışıyor. Kısa bir selamlaşma, tanışma ve hal hatır sorma.
text:
Mert: Hello! Excuse me, are you a student here?
Lena: Hi! Yes, I am. My name is Lena.
Mert: I am Mert. Where are you from, Lena?
Lena: I am from Germany. I live in Bremen. And you?
Mert: I am from Turkey. I live in this town now.
Lena: How are you today?
Mert: I am fine, thanks. But I am very hungry! And you?
Lena: I am not hungry, I am thirsty. And I am a little tired.
Mert: Are you a teacher too?
Lena: No, I am not a teacher. I am a student.
Mert: Good! See you on Monday. Goodbye!
Lena: Goodbye, Mert!

questions.text: Where is Lena from?
questions.explain: „I am from Germany. I live in Bremen.“ — ülke Almanya, şehir Bremen.

questions.text: How is Mert today?
questions.explain: „I am fine, thanks. But I am very hungry!“ — yorgun ve susamış olan Lena.

questions.text: Lena is a teacher.
questions.explain: „No, I am not a teacher. I am a student.“ — öğretmen değil, öğrenci.

questions.text: Lena lives in ___.
questions.explain: „I live in Bremen.“ — Almanya ülkesi, Bremen şehri; boşluğa şehir giriyor.

questions.text: Konuşmanın sırası: doğru sıraya koy.
questions.explain: Önce soru, sonra ad, sonra „nerelisin“, sonra ülke. Tanışma hep bu sırayla gidiyor.

questions.text: Is Mert from Turkey?
questions.explain: „I am from Turkey.“ — evet. Kısa cevap „Yes, he is.“ biçiminde kurulur.

title: I introduce myself
intro: Kendini tanıtmayı yazarak çalış. Önce parçaları birleştir, sonra tanışma kartını doldur.

tasks.hint: „My name is …“ + ad. İngilizcede özne düşmez: „My name“ olmadan cümle kurulmaz.

alternatives: I'm from Turkey.
tasks.hint: Ülke için „from“: I am from + ülke. Kısası „I'm from …“.
Şehir için „in“: I live in + şehir. „from“ geldiğin yeri, „in“ yaşadığın yeri söyler.

alternatives: I'm not a teacher.
tasks.hint: Olumsuzluk „not“ ile ve fiilden SONRA: am + not. Meslekten önce „a“ gerekir.

tasks.facts: Ali Demir; Türkiye'den; şu an Bremen'de yaşıyor.

title: Questions and answers
intro: Soru sormayı ve olumsuz cümleyi yaz. İngilizcede soru, „be“ fiilinin öne geçmesiyle kurulur.

tasks.hint: Soru sözcüğü „how“ başta, sonra „are you“. Sıra hep böyle.

alternatives: You aren't a student.
tasks.why: „not“ fiilden sonra gelir: are + not. Konuşmada „aren't“ diye büzülür.
Soruda „be“ fiili özneden ÖNE geçer: You are → Are you? Türkçedeki „-mi“ eki gibi ayrı bir sözcük yok.

tasks.hint: „where“ + „are you“ + „from“. Türkçede tek sözcük olan soru, İngilizcede dört sözcük.

alternatives: I'm fine, thanks.
tasks.hint: „fine“ hal hatır sorusunun hazır cevabı; „good“ da doğaldır.

title: English course — A1
intro: Bir dil okulunun kurs ilanını oku: ne zaman başlıyor, kim veriyor, ne kadar tutuyor.
text:
ENGLISH COURSE — A1

Do you speak a little English? Come and learn with us.

The course is easy. We start on Monday, September 7. One lesson is ninety minutes. We write words, we say words, and we spell our names.

Your teacher is Nora Scott. She is from Ireland. She is a very good teacher.

Price: forty euros for one month. For students: thirty euros. How much is a pen? One euro.

Do you understand every word? No — and that is not a problem. We say it again.

questions.text: When does the course start?
questions.explain: „We start on Monday, September 7.“ — bir ay fiyatın süresi, başlangıç günü değil.

questions.text: Where is the teacher from?
questions.explain: „Your teacher is Nora Scott. She is from Ireland.“

questions.text: The course is forty euros for students.
questions.explain: Öğrenciler için otuz euro: „For students: thirty euros.“ Kırk euro ötekiler için.

questions.text: One lesson is ___ minutes.
questions.explain: „One lesson is ninety minutes.“ Sayıyı yazıyla da rakamla da yazabilirsin.

questions.text: How much is a pen?
questions.explain: „How much is a pen? One euro.“ — fiyatta „years old“ gibi bir ek yok, sayı tek başına duruyor.

title: What do you do?
intro: İki kişi işlerini, yaşlarını ve konuştukları dilleri anlatıyor.
text:
Ana: Hello! I am Ana. What do you do?
Sam: Hi, Ana. I am a doctor. I work in a big hospital. And you?
Ana: I am a singer. I work in a school too — I am a music teacher there.
Sam: Very good! Do you speak English?
Ana: Yes, I do. I speak a little English and a little German.
Sam: How do you spell your name?
Ana: A, N, A. It is easy!
Sam: And how old are you, Ana?
Ana: I am twenty-nine years old. And you?
Sam: I am forty. My job is not easy, but I am happy.
Ana: Can you say that again, please? You speak very fast!
Sam: I said: I am happy.

questions.explain: „I am a doctor. I work in a big hospital.“ — şarkıcı ve müzik öğretmeni olan Ana.

questions.text: Ana speaks a little German.
questions.explain: „I speak a little English and a little German.“ — iki dili de az konuşuyor.

questions.explain: „I work in a big hospital.“

questions.text: How does Ana spell her name?
questions.explain: „A, N, A. It is easy!“ — harfleme harfleri tek tek söylemektir.

title: Numbers and spelling
intro: Yaşı, fiyatı ve harflemeyi yazarak çalış. Sonunda kurs formunu doldur.

alternatives: I'm thirty years old.
tasks.hint: Yaşta „years old“ ZORUNLU: sayı tek başına kalmaz.
„a little“ sayılamayan şeyler için: a little English, a little water.
Fiyat sorusu „how much“ ile. Yaş sorusunda „how old“ vardı — ikisi karışmasın.
Soru „do“ ile kuruluyor, çünkü fiil „be“ değil: How do you …?

tasks.facts: Emre Kaya; 22 yaşında; öğretmen; Bremen'de yaşıyor.

title: Do you speak English?
intro: „do“ ile kurulan soruyu ve kısa cevabı yaz. „be“ ile kurulan soruyla karışması kolay.

tasks.hint: Fiil „be“ değilse soru „do“ ile başlar: Do you …? Fiilin kendisi değişmez.

tasks.why: Kısa cevap sorunun yardımcı fiilini tekrarlar: soru „do“ ile kurulduysa cevap da „do“ taşır.

alternatives: No, I do not.
tasks.why: Olumsuz kısa cevapta „not“ yardımcı fiile yapışır: do + not → don't.

tasks.hint: İş yeri için „in“: I work in a school, in a hospital.
İki „do“ var: ilki soruyu kuran yardımcı, ikincisi „yapmak“ fiili.

title: This is my family
intro: Ayla ailesini anlatıyor. Okurken kimin kim olduğunu ve yaşları takip et.
text:
Hello! My name is Ayla. This is my family.

My mother is a doctor. Her name is Sevgi. She is fifty-two years old. My father is a teacher. His name is Kemal.

I have got one sister and one brother. My sister is twenty and my brother is only nine. He is still a boy, but he grows very fast!

My grandma and my grandpa live in a small town. Their house is old. We are there in May, for my grandma's birthday. We eat cake and we are all very happy.

title: His name, her name
intro: Aileni yaz. Dikkat: İngilizcede iyelik ayrı bir sözcük ve SAHİBİN cinsiyetine göre değişiyor.

alternatives: I have got a brother.
tasks.hint: „have got“ sahip olmayı söyler; konuşmada „I've got“ diye büzülür.
Türkçe iyelik eki isme takılıyor (anne-m), İngilizce ayrı sözcük koyuyor: my mother.
Kemal erkek, o yüzden „his“. Kadın olsaydı „her name“ olurdu — iyelik SAHİBE bakıyor.

tasks.why: „have got“ sorusunda „have“ öne geçer, tıpkı „be“ gibi: You have → Have you?

alternatives: She has got two children.
tasks.hint: Üçüncü tekil kişide „have“ → „has“: she has got, he has got.

title: Our animals
intro: Bir aile evcil hayvanlarını anlatıyor. Kimin hangi hayvanı var, hangisi ne yapmıyor?
text:
Hello! This is a photo of my family and our animals.

I have a dog. Its name is Luna. Luna is very big and she is not young. She plays with my brother. My sister has two cats. Their names are Mia and Nil. The cats don't play with Luna — they only sleep.

We have a bird too. Its name is Pit. Pit doesn't talk, and he never sings. My father says: "Don't forget the bird!"

We don't have a horse. A horse is for a farm, not for a house. But there are many horses at the zoo.

questions.explain: „I have a dog. Its name is Luna.“ — Mia kedilerden biri, Pit kuş.

title: Who is this?
intro: Eda bir fotoğrafı anlatıyor. „this“, „that“ ve „these“ arasındaki farka dikkat et.
text:
Ali: This is a good photo. Who is this?
Eda: This is my mother. And these are my friends.
Ali: How many people are there in the photo?
Eda: There are many people — one, two, three … eight!
Ali: Is that a man or a woman?
Eda: That is a man. He doesn't live here. He is from Ankara.
Ali: And this group here?
Eda: Those are my cousins. I don't know all their names!
Ali: You have a big family.
Eda: Yes. But I don't have a brother. I only have two sisters.
Ali: Is there an animal in the photo?
Eda: Yes, there is a dog. Its name is Nero. Don't forget Nero!

questions.text: How many people are there in the photo?
questions.explain: „one, two, three … eight!“ — Eda sayıyor ve sekizde bitiriyor.

questions.explain: „there is a dog. Its name is Nero.“ — hayvan için „its“ kullanılıyor.

questions.text: Eda has a brother.
questions.explain: „But I don't have a brother. I only have two sisters.“

questions.text: Eda only has two ___.
questions.explain: „I only have two sisters.“ — iki tane olduğu için çoğul: sister → sisters.

questions.text: Konuşmanın sırası: doğru sıraya koy.
items: How many people are there in the photo?
questions.explain: Önce tek kişi sorulur, sonra kaç kişi olduğu. „who“ kişiyi, „how many“ sayıyı sorar.

questions.explain: „He doesn't live here. He is from Ankara.“

title: I don't …
intro: Olumsuz cümleyi yaz. Dikkat: üçüncü tekil kişide „don't“ değil „doesn't“ geliyor.

tasks.hint: Hayvan için „a“ gerekir: a dog, a cat. Türkçede böyle bir sözcük yok.

alternatives: I do not have a cat.
tasks.why: Fiil „be“ değilse olumsuzluk „don't“ ile kurulur ve fiilden ÖNCE gelir.

alternatives: She does not have a bird.
tasks.why: Üçüncü tekil kişide „don't“ → „doesn't“ VE fiil ekini kaybeder: has → have.

tasks.hint: Emir olumsuzu „Don't“ ile başlar; özne yazılmaz.
Çoğulda „this“ → „these“ ve „is“ → „are“. İkisi birlikte değişir.

title: One or many
intro: Tekil ile çoğulu yaz. İngilizcede çoğul, ismi ve ona bağlı sözcükleri birlikte değiştiriyor.

tasks.hint: Sayı birden çoksa isim „-s“ alır: two friends.
„people“ zaten çoğul, „-s“ almaz ve „are“ ister.

tasks.why: Üç sözcük birden değişir: this → these, is → are, friend → friends.
„man“ düzensiz çoğul: men, „mans“ değil. Ayrıca çoğulda „a“ düşer.

tasks.hint: Soru sözcüğü başta, sonra „is this“. Yakındaki kişi için „this“.

title: My friend Kaan
intro: Bir arkadaş anlatılıyor: hem nasıl göründüğü hem nasıl biri olduğu.
text:
My friend Kaan is nineteen. He is very tall and he has got short hair. His eyes are green.

Kaan is not quiet. He is funny, and he talks a lot. He is kind too — he never forgets a birthday.

We work together in a small school. After work we play a game or we talk about music. Kaan likes music very much.

Kaan's cousin Ada is in our club. She is quiet, but she is nice. Her hair is long and she looks like Kaan. They are a funny group!

questions.explain: „My friend Kaan is nineteen.“ — yaşta „years old“ düşebiliyor.

questions.text: Kaan is quiet.
questions.explain: „Kaan is not quiet. He is funny, and he talks a lot.“ Sessiz olan kuzeni Ada.

questions.text: Kaan has got ___ hair.
questions.explain: „he has got short hair“ — Ada'nınki uzun.

questions.text: Who is Ada?
questions.explain: „Kaan's cousin Ada is in our club.“ — iyelik „-'s“ ile: Kaan's cousin.

title: What does he look like?
intro: Sena akrabalarını anlatıyor. „look like“ görünüşü sorar — cevabı da görünüş olmalı.
text:
Mert: Who is that man? Is he your uncle?
Sena: No, he isn't. That is my grandfather.
Mert: Really? He looks very strong!
Sena: Yes, he is. He is seventy-one, but he plays with us every day.
Mert: And the woman with him?
Sena: That is my grandmother. My grandparents live together in Izmir.
Mert: What does your aunt look like?
Sena: She is short and she has got long hair. She is very funny.
Mert: Is she busy?
Sena: Yes, she is always busy. She has got four children.
Mert: Four! Ali's cousin has got four children too.
Sena: I know. Ada is my friend.

questions.explain: „No, he isn't. That is my grandfather.“ — Mert amcası sanıyor, Sena düzeltiyor.

questions.explain: „She is short and she has got long hair.“ — „funny“ ve „busy“ görünüş değil, karakter.

questions.text: Sena's grandparents live in Izmir.
questions.explain: „My grandparents live together in Izmir.“ — ikisi birlikte.

questions.text: Sena's aunt has got ___ children.
questions.explain: „She has got four children.“

She is short and she has got long hair.

questions.explain: „He is seventy-one, but he plays with us every day.“

title: He is very kind

intro: Restoranda sipariş ve hesap. Sipariş kalıplarına dikkat: „I'd like“ ve „I'll have“ aynı işi görüyor.

Waiter: Good evening. A table for two?
Ali: Yes, please. A table for two.
Waiter: Here is the menu. What would you like?
Ali: I'd like a soup, please. And a water.
Eda: I'll have a sandwich with cheese, please.
Waiter: Anything else?
Eda: No, thank you. But can I have a spoon? There is only a knife here.
Waiter: Of course. One moment, please.

Waiter: Five euros. The sandwich is four euros.
Eda: Can I have the bill, please?
Waiter: Yes. It is nine euros.
Ali: Here is the money. Thank you!

intro: Sipariş kalıplarını yaz. Sonunda kafe siparişi formunu doldur.

tasks.answer: Can I have a coffee, please?
tasks.hint: „a coffee“ bir fincan kahve demek; madde olarak kahve „coffee“ olurdu.

alternatives: I would like a tea, please.

tasks.hint: Hesap tektir ve bellidir: „the bill“, „a bill“ değil.

title: Some or any?
intro: „some“ olumlu cümlede, „any“ soru ve olumsuzda. Türkçede böyle bir ayrım yok.

tasks.hint: Olumlu cümlede „some“. „bread“ sayılamaz, o yüzden „a bread“ olmaz.
Soruda „any“ ve tekil „is there“, çünkü süt sayılamaz.

tasks.why: Fiil „be“ değil, o yüzden soru „do“ ile kuruluyor ve fiil olduğu gibi kalıyor.

title: The food I love
intro: Biri sevdiği ve sevmediği yemekleri anlatıyor. Kim neyi tercih ediyor?
text:
I love food. I cook every day, and I like eating with my family.

The food I love most is pizza with meat and onion. I don't like sweet food — I hate very sweet cakes! My sister prefers rice. She says rice is cheap and easy.

At the market I buy meat, onions and rice. The meat is expensive: nine euros a kilo. In a sale it is cheaper.

I prefer tea to coffee. In the morning I drink a big cup of tea with milk. My father drinks only water. He says: "Don't cook with wine!"

title: At the market
intro: Pazarda pazarlık. Kilo, gram ve fiyat art arda geliyor — sayıları takip et.
text:
Seller: Good morning! How many kilos do you want?
Ayla: Two kilos of tomatoes, please. Are they fresh?
Seller: Very fresh. They are from a farm near the city.
Ayla: How much is it?
Seller: Four euros. Tomatoes are cheap this week — it's a sale.
Ayla: Good. And the meat? I'd like five hundred grams.
Seller: The meat is eighteen euros a kilo, so nine euros.
Ayla: Nine euros! That's too expensive for me.

title: My day
intro: Bir günün tamamı saatleriyle anlatılıyor. Hangi iş hangi saatte?
text:
I wake up at six and I get up at a quarter past six. I take a shower and then I have breakfast: bread, cheese and a cup of tea.

I work from eight until five. At lunchtime I eat a sandwich with tomatoes and carrots. I don't work on Sunday.

After work I buy fruit and vegetables at the market: apples, potatoes and bananas. A kilo of apples costs two euros.

I have dinner at half past seven. At midnight I sleep. I am always tired at night!

title: My week
intro: Bir haftanın düzeni. Hangi iş her zaman, hangisi bazen yapılıyor?
text:
I always get up at seven, also at the weekend. First I wake up, then I put on my clothes and I turn on the radio.

On Monday and on Friday I work in the city. I usually walk to work. Sometimes I am late, but my teacher is never angry.

In the evening I turn off the radio and I sit down with a newspaper. I often sit there until midnight.

At the weekend I look for a good game. After that I cook. Finally, before I sleep, I drink a cup of warm milk. That is my usual day.

Teacher: It's only a quarter past nine. What time do you get up?
Ali: I usually wake up at seven, but today my clock doesn't work.
Teacher: Turn on your phone at night, then.
Ali: I always turn it off before I sleep.
Teacher: Then look for a new clock at the weekend!
Ali: Yes. On Saturday I have time.
Teacher: Good. Now, first take off your bag and sit down.
Ali: Sorry again!
Teacher: Never mind. We begin at half past nine. You are not late.

Shop: Yes, your card is ready. Don't be late — we close at seven!

title: Buying a ticket
intro: Gişede bilet alınıyor. Peron, saat, fiyat ve rötar — dördünü de yakala.
text:
Ali: Good morning. I'd like a ticket to London, please.
Clerk: Single or return?
Ali: Return, please. When does the next train leave?
Clerk: At ten past nine, from platform four.
Ali: How much is it?
Clerk: Forty euros. Do you want a seat near the window?
Ali: Yes, please. And how long does it take?
Clerk: Two hours. But the train is running late today — twenty minutes.
Ali: Twenty minutes! How long is the delay in the evening?
Clerk: I am sorry, I don't know. Please wait here and listen.
Ali: Thank you. Is the airport near the station?
Clerk: No, it is far. Take a taxi from the square in front of the station.

title: Places to visit
intro: Şehir rehberi. Ne zaman açık, nereye nasıl gidiliyor?
text:
WELCOME TO OUR CITY

You can visit the museum every day from ten to six. The museum of art is near the park, behind the old church.

Can I see the park? Of course — the park is open at all hours and it is free. You can go on foot or by bike.

The church is open today, but not on Monday. Photography is not a problem, but please be quiet.

At the information desk you can ask for a map. A visitor can also take a boat on the river. The boat starts every hour.

title: My apartment
intro: Bir daire tanıtılıyor. Hangi oda nerede, içinde ne var?
text:
This is my home. It is an apartment on the second floor, with three rooms.

There is a big living room with a sofa and a lamp. The kitchen is small, but there is a fridge and a table with four chairs. There are two bedrooms. In my bedroom there is a bed under the window.

Is there a bathroom? Yes, there is one next to the kitchen. The toilet is in the bathroom.

We also have a cellar downstairs. The stairs are old, so please be quiet on them. My neighbour is very friendly, but she works at night.

Ela: No, only a book and a lamp are on the table.
Can: Under the sofa?
Ela: No. And not under the bed.
Can: In the kitchen? Next to the fridge?
Ela: I look. No, it is not there. Is there a phone in the bathroom?
Can: Why a phone in the bathroom? But look, please.
Ela: No! Wait — I call it.
Can: Good idea. Listen. I hear something. It is in the living room!
Ela: Where? Next to the chair, on the floor!
Can: Under the chair, I think. Now be quiet, please — the neighbour downstairs!

title: House rules
intro: Apartman kuralları. Ne yasak, ne serbest, ne zaman?
text:
HOUSE RULES

You must be quiet from ten at night to seven in the morning. You mustn't make noise on Sunday.

The stairs must be clean. Please put the rubbish in the bin downstairs, not in front of your door.

Is it allowed to have a party? Yes, but you have to ask your neighbours. A party has to end at eleven.

Water and electricity are not included in the rent. Each apartment pays the bill every month.

In a fire: don't take the lift. Go down the stairs.

Thank you!

Kaan: Can you help me? This box is very heavy.
Ela: Of course. What is in it?
Kaan: Books. Twenty books in one box — that was not a good idea.
Ela: I can carry it with you. One, two, three, up!
Kaan: Thank you. Please put it down here, next to the door.
Ela: Is the new apartment far?
Kaan: No, it is in this street. But it is on the fourth floor and the lift doesn't work.
Ela: The stairs then! Is the box hard or soft?
Kaan: Hard. Don't push it — carry it.
Ela: I understand. How much is the rent there?
Kaan: Eight hundred euros a month. Water is included, electricity is not.
Ela: That is expensive. But the apartment is clean and new.

title: Balcony and garden
intro: Bahçe ve balkon anlatılıyor. Ne var, ne bozuk?
text:
We have a small garden behind the house. There is a tree and there are many flowers.

In the sun the flowers are beautiful, but the ground is dry. I water the plants every morning. My neighbour has a field outside the city — that is a big garden!

On the balcony there are two chairs and a table. In the summer we eat outside. My son plays football in the garden, and sometimes the ball goes over the wall.

Is there a tap in the garden? Yes, next to the door. But the tap is broken — it doesn't work. I call a man on Monday.

title: It doesn't work

Office: Good morning. What is wrong?
Ela: The tap in the kitchen is broken. It doesn't work.
Office: Only the tap? Is the water in the bathroom good?
Ela: Yes, the bathroom is fine. But there is water on the floor.
Office: I understand. Can you call me this afternoon?
Ela: Of course. And one more thing: the printer in the cellar doesn't work too.
Office: The printer is not our work. Call the shop.
Ela: And the telephone in the hall?
Office: Is it broken too? Then we come on Wednesday.
Ela: Can you fix the tap today? The water is everywhere!
Office: Yes, today. Somebody comes at four.

intro: Parkta bir pazar. Ne var, hava nasıl, kışın ne oluyor?

On Sunday we go to the park. There is a big playground for children and there are many trees.

There is a lake with two boats. My son plays with a ball on the grass. Our dog runs everywhere.

Is there a café in the park? Yes, next to the lake. In the sun we sit outside and listen to music.

Today it is sunny, but yesterday it was cold and there was rain. In the winter there is snow here and the lake is hard. Then the children play on the lake — but that is not for me!

intro: Havuz anlatılıyor. Su ne zaman soğuk, çocuklar nerede öğreniyor?
text:
In the summer I go to the pool every week. I can swim, but not very fast.

The water is cold in the morning and warm in the afternoon. I take a towel and my earphones — I listen to music in the water.

There are two pools. One is deep, one is not. The children learn to swim in the small pool. They jump in the water all day.

Can you swim? If not, there is a course here. It is not boring: you learn in two weeks and then you can jump too.

title: Maybe next time
intro: Bir davet reddediliyor ama kapı kapanmıyor. Reddin üç parçasını bul.
text:
Ali: I'm going to meet Deniz tomorrow. Are you going to come?
Nil: Tomorrow? I'm afraid I can't. I'm busy.
Ali: And later, at seven?
Nil: Sorry, I'm busy today and tomorrow. Maybe next time.
Ali: No problem. What do you do?
Nil: I work, and in the evening I watch a series. Every evening!
Ali: Which channel?
Nil: It is not on a channel. I watch it on the computer.
Ali: Is it interesting?

title: Parts of the body
intro: Vücut bölümleri ve ağrının iki söyleniş biçimi.
text:
This is my body. This is my head, and these are my ears. My hands have five fingers each.

Is this your arm? Yes, and this is my shoulder. The leg is long and the knee is in the middle of it.

Where is the heart? On the left side, in the body. The blood goes from the heart to every finger.

When something hurts, we say: "My head hurts" or "I have a headache." Both are good English. If you feel very bad, you must go to a doctor.

title: Healthy living
intro: Sağlıklı yaşam öğütleri. Ne yapmalı, ne yapmamalı?
text:
Do you want to be healthy? It is simple.

You should eat fruit every day: an apple, a banana, a carrot. A salad with chicken is good for dinner too.

You shouldn't smoke. And you shouldn't eat a big dinner at ten in the evening.

Should I do exercise? Yes! Twenty minutes a day is good. You can walk, run or swim — all three are exercise.

Is weight a problem? Then you should drink more water and eat less sugar. But be careful: a fast change is not healthy. Slow is better.

Dentist: Which tooth? This one?
Kaan: Yes! That one.
Dentist: Does it hurt with cold water?
Kaan: Very much. And with ice cream too. And with lemon.
Dentist: I see. The tooth is not clean here. Do you eat a lot of sugar?
Kaan: Maybe. I eat ice cream every evening.
Dentist: Then you should eat less ice cream. And you should come every year.
Kaan: I know. I am here after four years.
Dentist: Four years! Today I clean the tooth. Come again in one week.
Kaan: Does it hurt today?
Dentist: A little. But after that you feel better.

Dear Anna,

Thank you very much for your message. I was at home yesterday and I read it in the evening.

I have a question: which website do you use for the course? I try two, but I don't find the class.

Clerk: Then it is two euros.

Clerk: One euro.
Ela: I have a parcel too. How much is that?
Clerk: The parcel is heavy. Nine euros. Is it full?

Ela: Can I have two stamps, please? For two letters tomorrow.

Ela: The address of the parcel is on the paper.
Clerk: Good. Twelve euros together, please.
Ela: Here is my card. Thank you!

title: My last weekend
intro: Geçen hafta sonu anlatılıyor. Düzensiz geçmiş biçimlerini yakala.
text:
What did you do last weekend? I went to the mountains with two friends.

We went by train on Saturday morning. The weather was sunny. We walked four hours and we saw a river and a small farm.

In the evening we ate in a café near the lake. I had soup and bread, my friend had chicken.

On Sunday I visited my grandmother. She was very happy. We watched a film and I finished my homework there.

I didn't watch TV in the evening — I was too tired. I went to bed at nine!

title: I lost my phone
intro: Kaybolan bir telefonun hikâyesi. Ne zaman ne oldu, sırasıyla takip et.
text:
Last week I lost my phone on the bus. It was a bad day.

I was waiting for the bus in the rain. When the bus came, I was holding my bag in one hand and my phone in the other. I got in, I sat down and I fell asleep.

Two stops later I woke up suddenly and I ran out. The phone was on the seat.

I went back to the bus station the day before yesterday. A woman there was very kind. "Somebody brought a phone yesterday," she said. And it was my phone!

I bought a small bag for the phone. Now I always put it in the bag. I don't want to lose it again.

Ali: I called again at nine.

Sena: This morning I was waiting for the bus when I saw your message.
Ali: Good. I lost my keys last week and I found them yesterday — in your car!
Sena: In my car! When did you leave them there?
Ali: Two weeks ago, I think. I was wearing a big jacket that day and the keys fell down.
Sena: Then come and take them. I am at home now.

title: My childhood
intro: Bir çocukluk anlatısı. Eskiden ne vardı, sonra ne değişti?
text:
I grew up in a small village near the sea. When I was a child, we didn't have a computer and I didn't use to watch television.

First I went to kindergarten in the village, then to the primary school in the next town. Every morning we walked twenty minutes, and in the winter it was very cold.

I used to play football in the yard with the children of our neighbours. My sister used to play with her doll and she used to shout at us because we were loud.

After that, when I was ten, we moved to the city. At first I didn't like it. The new school was big and I didn't know anybody.

But I remember one good thing: the city had a library. I used to read there every afternoon.

title: A holiday I remember
intro: Bir tatil anlatısı. Sıralama sözcüklerini takip et: first, then, after that, finally.
text:
I went to Antalya last summer with two friends. It was my first flight.

First we took a taxi to the airport. Then we waited two hours because the plane was late. At first I was angry, but afterwards it was fine.

We stayed at a small hotel for five days. The weather was hot and the beach was beautiful. Every morning we swam in the sea, and after that we ate fruit in the shade.

One day we took a boat to an island. While we were on the boat, a big fish jumped out of the water. My friend was wearing a white shirt and the water made it wet. That's why we have a funny photo of that day.

I enjoyed the holiday very much. Next year I want to go again.

title: What happened?
intro: Küçük bir kaza anlatılıyor. Ne oldu, ne kadar ciddi, sonrası ne?
text:
Sena: What happened to your arm?
Ali: I fell on the stairs yesterday and I hurt my arm. Luckily, it wasn't serious.
Sena: Where did it happen?
Ali: At home. I was carrying two boxes and I didn't see the last step.
Sena: Were you alone?
Ali: Yes, I was alone. But my neighbour heard me and she came fast.
Sena: Did you go to the doctor?
Ali: Yes. I waited two hours there. The doctor said: No break, only a bad injury.
Sena: How long do you have to wait?
Ali: Two weeks with no heavy work. Bad luck — we are moving to a new flat next month!
Sena: Then I help you. I have moved four times in my life.
Ali: Really? Thank you very much.

Nil: Have you ever been abroad?
Kaan: Yes, I have. I have been to Italy twice.
Nil: Twice! When was the first time?
Kaan: Three years ago. I went with my sister and we stayed in a hostel.
Nil: Have you ever tried Italian food there?
Kaan: Of course. Every day! It was exciting.
Nil: I have never been abroad. But my brother has gone to London — he is away this week.
Kaan: Is he coming back soon?
Nil: Yes, he comes back on Sunday. He goes there once a year for his work.
Kaan: Then ask him about foreign countries. He knows a lot.
Nil: I will. Have you ever been to England?
Kaan: No, I haven't. But I want to go.

title: My life story
intro: Bir hayat hikâyesi. „since“ ve „for“ art arda geçiyor — hangisi süre, hangisi başlangıç?
text:
I was born in a small town in the north. My parents worked in a factory and we lived there for eleven years.

Then I moved to the city because I wanted to study. I have lived here since two thousand and fifteen — that is ten years.

At the university I met my wife. We have known each other for nine years now. Our marriage was in May, and since then my life has changed a lot.

I have already finished my studies, but I haven't found a good job yet. I work in a café at the moment. It is not bad: the people are friendly and the hours are on time.

Next year I'm going to look for work abroad. I promise I won't stay in the café for years!

title: Me, then and now
intro: On yıl önce ve şimdi. Ne değişti, ne aynı kaldı?
text:
Ten years ago my life was very different. I used to work in a big office in the city. The job was important but difficult, and I was tired every evening.

Now I work at home. The money is less, but the hours are better and I am still here at six when my children come back from school.

I used to travel a lot. I don't travel anymore — or almost not. Last year I was abroad only once.

Some things are the same. I still read every night, and my favourite café is still the little one near the park. It is tiny, but the coffee is excellent and it is cheaper than the big places in the centre.

My dream is to write a book. That is my goal for the next two years.

title: The best day
intro: Hayatın en güzel günü anlatılıyor. Üstünlük biçimlerini yakala.
text:
The best day of my life was in June two years ago. It was not a big day for other people, but for me it was excellent.

I had an opportunity: a company abroad wanted me for a new job. The letter came in the morning. I read it three times.

The job was more important than my old one, and the money was better too. But the best thing was not the money. The best thing was this: somebody read my work and said yes.

I called my mother and she cried. Then I called my sister — she is the most practical person in our family — and she asked: "Is the flat cheaper there or more expensive?"

It's the best memory I have ever had. And yes, the flat was more expensive.

title: Describing symptoms
intro: Hekimde şikâyet anlatılıyor. Ne kadar zamandır, ne kadar ciddi?
text:
Doctor: Good morning. What is the problem?
Ela: I have a fever and my throat is sore. I've had a cough for three days.
Doctor: How long have you had the fever?
Ela: Since Monday. It started in the evening.
Doctor: And is it worse now or better?
Ela: Worse. Yesterday I was dizzy in the morning and I couldn't work.
Doctor: Do you have a pain in the stomach?
Ela: No, only the throat and the head.
Doctor: It is a cold, not a serious illness. You should rest for a week.
Ela: A week! I have a lot of work.
Doctor: Then you will be ill for a month. You should drink enough water, avoid cold drinks and relax.
Ela: Should I take vitamins?
Doctor: They don't hurt. But rest is the best medicine.

title: Changing an appointment
intro: Randevu değiştiriliyor. Hangi gün kalıyor, hangisi iptal?
text:
Deniz: Good morning. I'd like to change my appointment.
Office: Of course. What is your name?
Deniz: Deniz Kaya. The appointment is on Friday at ten.
Office: I see it. When would you like to come?
Deniz: Do you have anything earlier? Friday is too late for me.
Office: Let me look. Wednesday at two is available. Or Thursday at half past eight.
Deniz: Thursday is better. Half past eight is fine.
Office: Good. And Friday? Do I cancel it?
Deniz: Yes, please cancel it.
Office: Is the problem urgent?
Deniz: Not urgent, but I have had the pain for two weeks and it is getting worse.
Office: Then Thursday is good. If it is worse tomorrow, call back and we find something today.
Deniz: Thank you. I'll let you know.

title: Cinema on Saturday
intro: Deniz ile Emma'nın sinema planı yaptığı mesajlaşmayı okuyacaksın.
text:
Deniz: Hi Emma! What are you doing on Saturday?
Emma: Nothing special. I am at home. Why?
Deniz: There is a new film at the Star Cinema. It is a comedy.
Emma: Nice! What time does it start?
Deniz: At seven o'clock. But the tickets are cheap before six.
Emma: OK, can we meet early? I finish work at five.
Deniz: Sure. Let's meet at half past five in front of the cinema.
Emma: Perfect. Is Murat coming too?
Deniz: No, he is busy. He has got an exam on Monday.
Emma: Poor Murat! I have got twenty lira. Is that enough for a ticket?
Deniz: Yes, a ticket is fifteen lira. See you on Saturday!
Emma: See you!

Name: Elena Rossi
Age: 27
City: Milan, Italy
Job: nurse in a small hospital

About me:
Hello! I am Elena. I am 27 years old and I live in Milan with my sister. I work as a nurse. I start work at seven in the morning, so I am always tired at night!

I speak Italian and Spanish. Now I am learning English because I want to work in London. I have got a cat, and I love old films and long walks.

I am free on Tuesday and Thursday evenings. There is a nice café near my flat. We can talk there, or we can talk online. Please write me a message!

title: My Tuesday
intro: Bir öğrencinin salı gününü saat saat anlattığı günlük yazısını okuyacaksın.
text:
Tuesday, 14 March

I get up at half past six. I am always tired, but I open the window and drink a big glass of water.
At seven o'clock I have breakfast with my sister Elif. She makes tea.
I walk to school. It is twenty minutes.
Lessons start at eight. My favourite lesson is science, because our teacher is funny.
At half past twelve we have lunch. Today it is rice and a small salad.
After school I go to the library with Deniz. We do our homework there until five.
In the evening I help my mother in the kitchen. Then I watch a film.
I go to bed at eleven. Tomorrow is Wednesday and I have got a maths exam!

Greetings from Antalya! We arrived on Friday evening. The hotel is small but very nice. Our room has got a big balcony.

On Saturday we were at the beach all day. The water was warm and my brother swam for two hours. In the afternoon we ate fish at a small restaurant near the harbour. It cost only 200 lira!

On Sunday morning I visited the old town with Dad. We walked for three hours and I took forty photos. Mum stayed at the hotel because she was tired.

Now I am sitting on the balcony. The sun is going down and the sea is orange. I am writing this postcard to you.

See you next week!
Deniz

title: The Family Photo
intro: İki arkadaşın bir aile fotoğrafındaki kişileri konuştuğu diyaloğu dinleyeceksin.

segments.speaker: Emma
segments.text: Oh, is this your family photo? Can I see it?

segments.speaker: Kaan
segments.text: Sure. It's from my sister's birthday. There are six people here.

segments.speaker: Emma
segments.text: Who's the woman with short blonde hair?

segments.speaker: Kaan
segments.text: That's my aunt Julia. She's my mother's sister. She's a nurse.

segments.speaker: Emma
segments.text: And the tall man with glasses?

segments.speaker: Kaan
segments.text: That's my uncle. He's very tall, and he's got a big beard now.

segments.speaker: Emma
segments.text: Your sister looks young. How old is she?

segments.speaker: Kaan
segments.text: She's nineteen. She's studying music in London.

segments.speaker: Emma
segments.text: You two look the same! Same eyes, same smile.

questions.text: How many people are in the photo?
questions.explain: Kaan fotoğrafı gösterirken "There are six people here." diyor. Yani fotoğrafta altı kişi var.

questions.text: Julia is the sister of Kaan's mother.
questions.explain: Kaan "That's my aunt Julia. She's my mother's sister." diyor. Julia, annesinin kız kardeşi, yani teyzesi.

questions.text: What is Kaan's sister studying?
questions.explain: Kaan kız kardeşi için "She's nineteen. She's studying music in London." diyor.

questions.text: How does Kaan describe his uncle?
options: He is tall and he has got a beard.
He is short and he hasn't got glasses.
He has got short blonde hair.
questions.explain: Emma "the tall man with glasses" diye soruyor, Kaan da "He's very tall, and he's got a big beard now." diye cevaplıyor.

questions.text: Kaan's sister is ___ years old.
questions.explain: "She's nineteen. She's studying music in London."

questions.text: Where is Kaan's sister studying?
questions.explain: "She's studying music in London."

title: A Weekend Voice Message
intro: Bir arkadaşının hafta sonu planı için bıraktığı sesli mesajı dinleyeceksin.

segments.speaker: Voice message
segments.text: Hi Ayşe, it's Mert. I'm calling about the weekend. There's a music festival in the new park near the river. I'm going to meet Deniz there on Saturday at eleven o'clock.

segments.speaker: Voice message
segments.text: Can you come with us? The tickets are only twenty lira for students. That's cheap! I've got a big bag with sandwiches, so don't bring food. But please bring your camera.

segments.speaker: Voice message
segments.text: Saturday is sunny, but Sunday is rainy, so Saturday is better. Call me back tonight. My phone is on. Bye!

questions.text: What time are they meeting in the park?
questions.explain: Mert "I'm going to meet Deniz there on Saturday at eleven o'clock." diyor, yani buluşma saat on birde.

questions.text: How much is a student ticket?
questions.explain: "The tickets are only twenty lira for students." cümlesinden öğrenci biletinin yirmi lira olduğu anlaşılıyor.

questions.text: Mert wants Ayşe to bring food.
questions.explain: Yanlış. Mert "I've got a big bag with sandwiches, so don't bring food." diyor; yemeği kendisi getiriyor, ondan sadece fotoğraf makinesini istiyor.

questions.text: Why is Saturday better than Sunday?
options: Because the park is closed on Sunday
Because Deniz is busy on Sunday
questions.explain: "Saturday is sunny, but Sunday is rainy, so Saturday is better." cümlesinde pazar gününün yağmurlu olduğu söyleniyor.

questions.text: The student tickets are only ___ lira.
questions.explain: "The tickets are only twenty lira for students."

questions.text: What does Mert ask Ayşe to bring?
questions.explain: "don't bring food. But please bring your camera." Yiyeceği Mert getiriyor.

title: At the Doctor's
intro: Bir hastanın doktora şikâyetlerini anlattığı konuşmayı dinleyeceksin.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Good morning. Come in, please. What's the matter?

segments.speaker: Merve
segments.text: Good morning. I'm not feeling well. I've got a headache and a sore throat.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Have you got a fever?

segments.speaker: Merve
segments.text: Yes. This morning it's 38 degrees.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Okay. Open your mouth, please. Your throat is very red. It's just a bad cold.

segments.speaker: Merve
segments.text: Can you give me something for the pain?

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Sure. Here's a prescription. Take one tablet three times a day, after meals.

segments.speaker: Merve
segments.text: Thank you. Can I go to work tomorrow?

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: No, stay at home for two days. Drink a lot of water. Come back on Friday.

questions.text: What is Merve's problem?
options: A headache and a sore throat
questions.explain: Merve doktora 'I've got a headache and a sore throat.' diyor; yani başı ve boğazı ağrıyor.

questions.text: What is her temperature this morning?
questions.explain: Ateşi sorulunca 'Yes. This morning it's 38 degrees.' diyor.

questions.text: Merve can go to work tomorrow.
questions.explain: Doktor 'No, stay at home for two days.' diyor; yani yarın işe gidemez, iki gün evde kalacak.

questions.text: How many tablets a day does she take?
questions.explain: Doktor 'Take one tablet three times a day, after meals.' diyor; günde üç kez birer hap, yani üç hap.

questions.text: Merve must stay at home for ___ days.
questions.explain: "stay at home for two days." Yarın işe gidemiyor.

questions.text: When must Merve come back?
questions.explain: "Come back on Friday."

intro: Bir spor salonunun telefon bilgi kaydını dinleyeceksin: hangi gün, saat kaçta açık olduklarını ve fiyatları anlatıyor.

title: A Weekend in Izmir

questions.explain: "I went to Izmir with my sister."

Hi, my name is Elif.
Hello, my name is Elif
Hello, my name's Elif

I am from Turkey and I'm a student.

tasks.prompt: Kurs forumuna kendini tanıtan kısa bir mesaj yaz. Şu üçüne değin: (1) nereli olduğun ve nerede yaşadığın, (2) ne iş yaptığın ya da öğrenci olduğun, (3) boş zamanında ne yapmayı sevdiğin. Selamlama ile başla, kapanış cümlesiyle bitir.
checklist: Adını ve nereli olduğunu yazdın mı?
Mesleğini ya da öğrenci olduğunu 'I'm a ...' kalıbıyla söyledin mi?
Boş zamanında ne yapmayı sevdiğini anlattın mı?
Selamlama ve kapanış cümlesi (ör. 'Nice to meet you.') koydun mu?

title: My Family
intro: Aileni ve akrabalarını tanıtmayı, görünüşlerini anlatmayı ve bunu kısa bir e-postada toplamayı çalışacaksın.

I have two sisters.

I've got two sisters
I have two sisters
I've two sisters.

alternatives: My sister has long brown hair.
My sister's got long brown hair.
My sister has got long brown hair
My sister has long brown hair
tasks.hint: Üçüncü tekil kişide 'have' yerine 'has' gelir: she has got. 'Hair' tekil kullanılır, sonuna -s almaz.

checklist: Ailende kaç kişi olduğunu ve kim olduklarını yazdın mı?
Bir kişinin görünüşünü 'has got' ile anlattın mı?
Birlikte ne yaptığınızı geniş zamanda yazdın mı?
E-postanı bir selamlama ile başlatıp bir kapanışla bitirdin mi?

I have got a brother and a sister.
phrases.tr: Bir erkek kardeşim ve bir kız kardeşim var.

phrases.de: She has got short black hair.
He is tall and very funny.
phrases.tr: O uzun boylu ve çok komik.

tasks.sample:
Hi Emma,

How are you? Today I want to tell you about my family. There are five people in my family: my mother, my father, my two sisters and me. We live in Izmir.

My big sister is tall and she has got long brown hair and green eyes. My father is a teacher and he is very kind. My uncle lives near us, so we see him every week.

On Sundays we cook together and watch a film at home. I love my family very much.

Write soon and tell me about your family!

Love,
Deniz

title: How Was Your Weekend?
intro: Elif ile Kerem'in hafta sonlarını anlattıkları mesajlaşmayı okuyacaksın.
text:
Elif, 10:14
Hi Kerem! How was your weekend? I called you on Saturday but you never answered.

Kerem, 10:20
Sorry! I was on a train to Bursa. My cousin got married on Saturday evening, so the whole family travelled together.

Elif, 10:22
Wow, a wedding! Did you dance?

Kerem, 10:25
Of course. The music was louder than last year's party and we stayed until one o'clock. My little brother fell asleep on a chair.

Elif, 10:27
Poor kid. My weekend was quieter. I used to hate cooking, but now I really enjoy it. On Sunday I made lentil soup for my neighbours.

Kerem, 10:30
That sounds better than my Sunday. I slept until noon and then I cleaned the car.

Elif, 10:31
Have you finished your report yet?

Kerem, 10:33
Not yet! I must start tonight. I have never written thirty pages in one week.

Elif, 10:35
Good luck. I will bring you a cup of soup tomorrow. It is the best thing I have ever cooked.

title: My Life in Three Cities

text:
MY LIFE IN THREE CITIES
Posted by Elif Kaya · March 14

Hello! I have had this blog for two years now, but I have never told you my own story. So here it is.

I grew up in Izmir. My father was a fisherman, and I used to help him on the boat every summer. I hated it when I was ten. Now I miss it.

When I was nineteen, I moved to Ankara to study engineering. I was terrible at it. One evening, while I was studying for an exam, I started drawing small houses in my notebook. My teacher saw them and said, "You should study design."

I have lived in Istanbul since 2019. I work for a small studio near Kadıköy, and I have already designed four cafés. It is harder than engineering, but it is much more fun.

Next year I am going to open my own studio. I am a little afraid, but my father always says the same thing: "A fisherman must not wait for good weather." He is right.

Have you ever changed your job? Tell me below!

GREEN VALLEY HEALTH CENTRE
Free Wellness Programme — October

Do you feel tired every morning? Small changes can help.

SLEEP
You should go to bed before eleven o'clock. Avoid your phone in bed. Screens make sleep harder.

FOOD
Drink six glasses of water a day. You should eat fruit at breakfast. Avoid sugar in the afternoon — it gives you energy for twenty minutes only.

MOVE
Walking is the easiest exercise. Thirty minutes a day is enough. Our nurse, Elif Kaya, says: "I used to drive to work. Now I walk, and I feel much stronger than before."

Free classes every Tuesday at 6 p.m. in Room 4.
Yoga for beginners — bring a towel.
Cooking workshop — first Saturday of the month, 10 a.m.

We have already helped 300 people this year. You must call before you come, because the classes are small. Ring 0212 555 04 18.

Your health will thank you!

NOTICE — RETURNS AND EXCHANGES

Dear customers,

We changed our returns policy last month, so please read this notice.

You can bring an item back within 30 days. You must show the receipt. Without a receipt we cannot give your money back, but we can offer an exchange or a store card.

CLOTHES: please keep the label on the item. We have already helped hundreds of shoppers this year, and the label makes everything faster.

SHOES: you must not wear them outside. We only accept shoes in the original box.

ELECTRONICS: you have 14 days. Please bring the box, the cable and the charger.

The returns desk is on the second floor, next to the coffee shop. It opens at 10:00 every day and closes at 19:00. On Sundays it closes earlier, at 17:00.

Elif Demir, our new manager, will answer your questions on Saturday morning.

Thank you!

title: Old Mill Bridge Opens Again
intro: Yerel bir gazetede çıkan, yeniden açılan bir köprü haberini okuyacaksın.
text:
RIVERTON DAILY — Local News

Old Mill Bridge Opens Again
By Clara Novak, 12 May

The Old Mill Bridge opened again on Saturday morning after six months of repair work. More than three hundred people came to the small park next to the river at nine o'clock.

The mayor, Deniz Yalın, cut the red ribbon. "This bridge is safer and wider than the old one," she said. "Children can walk to school here now."

The bridge closed last November because heavy rain damaged the stone under it. While the workers were fixing it, people used the bus or drove ten kilometres to the next bridge. Many shops near the river lost money.

"I have lived here for thirty years, and I have never seen the bridge closed before," said Mr Owens, who sells bread on Green Street. "My customers are already coming back."

The town spent 1.2 million euros on the project. The council will plant fifty new trees along the river path next spring. Visitors should use the free car park behind the library.

questions.explain: "He was only nineteen" cümlesinden anlıyoruz; öğrenci o zaman on dokuz yaşındaydı.

questions.text: The app is completely free for everyone.
questions.explain: Yanlış. "It's free, but the special version costs 3 dollars a month" — özel sürüm ayda 3 dolar.

questions.text: What will the student do next week?
options: Sell the app to a big company
Open a small office in Istanbul
questions.explain: "Next week he will open a small office in Istanbul" diyor; gelecek hafta İstanbul'da küçük bir ofis açacak.

questions.text: The special version costs ___ dollars a month.
questions.explain: "It's free, but the special version costs 3 dollars a month."

questions.text: How many people use the app now?
questions.explain: "Now more than 400,000 people use the app."

title: My Weekend Message
intro: Hafta sonunu anlatmak için geçmiş zamanı ve sık kullanılan düzensiz fiilleri (go → went, have → had, buy → bought) çalışacaksın.

tasks.tr: Geçen hafta sonu ailemi ziyaret ettim.
tasks.answer: Last weekend I visited my family.
alternatives: Last weekend, I visited my family.
I visited my family last weekend.
I visited my family last weekend
tasks.hint: Düzenli fiillerin geçmiş hâli -ed alır: visit → visited.

tasks.answer: My friends and I went to the beach on Saturday.
alternatives: On Saturday, we went to the beach with my friends.
We went to the beach with my friends on Saturday.
On Saturday we went to the beach with our friends.
On Saturday my friends and I went to the beach.
I went to the beach with my friends on Saturday.
On Saturday we went to the beach with my friends.
tasks.hint: 'go' düzensizdir: geçmiş hâli 'goed' değil 'went' olur.

tasks.answer: I didn't do anything on Sunday.
alternatives: I did not do anything on Sunday.
I didn't do anything on Sunday
I did not do anything on Sunday
On Sunday I didn't do anything.
On Sunday I did not do anything.
tasks.hint: Olumsuzda 'didn't' kullanılır ve fiil yalın kalır: didn't do (did not did değil).

tasks.prompt: Arkadaşına hafta sonunu anlatan bir mesaj yaz. Şu üçüne değin: (1) hafta sonu nereye gittin ve kiminleydin, (2) orada ne yaptın (en az iki etkinlik anlat), (3) hafta sonun nasıl geçti ve arkadaşına ne öneriyorsun.
checklist: Nereye gittiğini ve kiminle olduğunu yazdın mı?
En az iki etkinliği geçmiş zamanla anlattın mı?
Düzensiz fiilleri doğru yazdın mı (went, had, bought, ate)?
Mesajı bir selamlama ile başlatıp kapanış cümlesiyle bitirdin mi?

phrases.de: Hi Emre! How was your weekend?
You should come with us next time.
phrases.tr: Bir dahaki sefere sen de bizimle gelmelisin.

tasks.sample: Hi Emre! How was your weekend? Last weekend I went to my grandmother's village with my family. On Saturday we walked in the forest and cooked outside. The market was very crowded on Sunday, but we bought fresh bread and cheese there. I came home tired, but I had a great time. You should come with us next month. Write back soon!

title: My Story in a Comment
intro: Bir blog yazısının altına kendi hikâyeni yazarken present perfect ile geçmiş zamanı birlikte kullanmayı çalışacaksın.

tasks.answer: I've studied English for two years.
alternatives: I have studied English for two years.
I have studied English for two years
I've studied English for two years
I have been studying English for two years.
I've been studying English for two years.
tasks.hint: Hâlâ süren bir durumu anlatmak için present perfect ve 'for' + süre kullanılır: I have studied … for two years.

tasks.tr: Geçen yaz ilk kez İstanbul'a gittim.
tasks.answer: Last summer I went to Istanbul for the first time.
alternatives: I went to Istanbul for the first time last summer.
Last summer, I went to Istanbul for the first time.
I went to Istanbul for the first time last summer
Last summer I went to Istanbul for the first time
tasks.hint: Belli bir geçmiş zaman ('last summer') varsa present perfect değil, past simple kullanılır: go fiilinin ikinci hâli went.

tasks.tr: Bu kitabı henüz okumadım ama çok merak ediyorum.
tasks.answer: I haven't read this book yet, but I'm really curious.
alternatives: I have not read this book yet, but I am really curious.
I haven't read this book yet but I'm really curious.
I have not read this book yet but I am really curious.
I have not read this book yet, but I am really curious
I haven't read this book yet, but I am really curious.
I have not read this book yet, but I'm really curious.
I've not read this book yet, but I am really curious.
I've not read this book yet, but I'm really curious.
tasks.hint: 'yet' olumsuz cümlenin sonuna gelir ve present perfect ile kullanılır: I haven't read it yet.

tasks.prompt: Bir dil öğrenme blogunda 'İngilizceyi nasıl öğrendim?' başlıklı bir yazı okudun. Yazının altına kendi hikâyeni anlatan kısa bir yorum yaz. Şu üçüne değin: (1) ne kadar zamandır İngilizce çalıştığın, (2) geçmişte yaşadığın somut bir anı (nerede, ne zaman, ne oldu), (3) henüz yapmadığın ama yakında yapmak istediğin bir şey.
checklist: Yazara bir selamlama ya da teşekkür cümlesiyle başladın mı?
Ne kadar zamandır çalıştığını 'for' veya 'since' ile present perfect kullanarak yazdın mı?
Geçmişteki anıyı past simple ile (went, was, talked gibi) anlattın mı?
Henüz yapmadığın şeyi 'haven't … yet' kalıbıyla belirtip yorumu kısa bir kapanışla bitirdin mi?
tasks.sample: Hi Deniz, thanks for this post! I've studied English for two years, and your story sounds like mine. Last summer I went to Istanbul for the first time and I spoke English with tourists there. I was very nervous, but the people were kind and they understood me. I haven't finished your book list yet, but I will start it this week. Have you ever tried a language exchange app? Thanks again and keep writing!

title: A Problem in the Flat
intro: Ev sahibine yazılan kısa bir e-postada evdeki arızayı bildirmeyi, sorunun ne zamandır sürdüğünü anlatmayı ve kibarca yardım istemeyi çalışacaksın.

tasks.answer: Hello, I'm your tenant on the third floor.
alternatives: Hello, I am your tenant on the third floor.
Hi, I'm your tenant on the third floor.
Hi, I am your tenant on the third floor.
tasks.hint: Kendini tanıtırken 'I'm' = 'I am'; kat söylerken 'on' kullanılır: on the third floor.

tasks.answer: The heater hasn't worked since yesterday evening.
alternatives: The heater has not worked since yesterday evening.
The heater hasn't been working since yesterday evening.
The heater has not been working since yesterday evening.
tasks.hint: Belirli bir başlangıç anı için 'since' kullanılır ve fiil present perfect olur: hasn't worked since… ('hasn't' = 'has not').

tasks.tr: Sıcak su olmadığı için duş alamıyorum.
tasks.answer: I can't take a shower because there's no hot water.
alternatives: I cannot take a shower because there is no hot water.
I can't have a shower because there's no hot water.
I cannot have a shower because there is no hot water.
I cannot take a shower because there's no hot water.
I can't take a shower because there is no hot water.
I cannot have a shower because there's no hot water.
I can't have a shower because there is no hot water.
tasks.hint: Bir şeyin hiç olmadığını söylerken 'there is no + isim' dersin; 'can't' = 'cannot'.

tasks.prompt: Ev sahibine dairedeki bir arızayı bildiren kısa bir e-posta yaz. Şu üçüne değin: (1) hangi arıza var ve ne zamandan beri sürüyor, (2) bu durum günlük hayatını nasıl etkiliyor, (3) ne yapmasını rica ediyorsun ve evde hangi saatlerde bulunuyorsun.
checklist: Hitap ve kapanış cümlesi (ör. 'Dear …' ve 'Best wishes') yazdın mı?
Arızanın ne zamandan beri sürdüğünü 'since' veya 'for' ile söyledin mi?
Sorunun seni nasıl etkilediğini en az bir cümleyle anlattın mı?
Ricanı kibar bir soruyla ('Could you please …?') yazdın ve evde olduğun saati belirttin mi?

phrases.de: I am writing about a problem in my flat.
Could you please send someone to repair it?
phrases.tr: Lütfen tamir için birini gönderebilir misiniz?

phrases.de: I am at home after five o'clock.

tasks.sample:
Dear Mr Brown,

I am writing about a problem in my flat. The heater hasn't worked since yesterday evening, so there is no hot water in the bathroom. The rooms are very cold at night and I can't take a shower before work.

Could you please send someone to repair it this week? I am at home after five o'clock every day.

Thank you for your help.

Best wishes,
Elif

title: Applying for a Job
intro: Bir iş ilanına kısa ve kibar bir başvuru e-postası yazmayı, deneyimini ve uygunluğunu anlatmayı çalışacaksın.

tasks.answer: I have worked in a restaurant for two years.
alternatives: I've worked in a restaurant for two years.
I have worked in a restaurant for two years
I've worked in a restaurant for two years
I have been working in a restaurant for two years.
I've been working in a restaurant for two years.
I have worked at a restaurant for two years.
I've worked at a restaurant for two years.
tasks.hint: Süre uzunluğu için 'for' kullanılır: for two years; başlangıç noktası için 'since' gelir.

tasks.tr: Bu iş için uygun kişi olduğumu düşünüyorum.
tasks.answer: I think I am the right person for this job.
alternatives: I think I'm the right person for this job.
I think I am the right person for this job
I think I'm the right person for this job
tasks.hint: 'the right person for …' kalıbı 'uygun kişi' demektir; sonrasında 'for' değişmez.

tasks.tr: Gelecek hafta bir görüşmeye gelmek isterim.
tasks.answer: I would like to come to an interview next week.
alternatives: I'd like to come to an interview next week.
I would like to come to an interview next week
I'd like to come to an interview next week
tasks.hint: Kibar istek için 'would like to' + yalın fiil kullanılır: would like to come.

tasks.prompt: Bir kafede garson arayan bir iş ilanı gördün. İşverene kısa bir başvuru e-postası yaz. Şu üçüne değin: (1) hangi ilan için yazdığın ve ilanı nerede gördüğün, (2) deneyimin ve ne zaman müsait olduğun, (3) neden bu iş için uygun kişi olduğun ve görüşme isteğin.
checklist: Hangi iş için yazdığını ve ilanı nerede gördüğünü belirttin mi?
Deneyimini 'for' ya da 'since' ile süre vererek anlattın mı?
Ne zaman müsait olduğunu yazdın mı?
Selamlama ve kapanış cümlesi kullandın mı?

phrases.de: I am writing about the … job.
I saw your job advertisement on …
I have worked as a … for … years.
I think I am the right person for this job.
phrases.tr: Bu iş için uygun kişi olduğumu düşünüyorum.

phrases.de: I would like to come to an interview.

tasks.sample:
Dear Mr Yilmaz,

I am writing about the waiter job at your cafe. I saw your job advertisement on your website yesterday. I have worked in a restaurant in Izmir for two years, so I have a lot of experience with customers. I can speak Turkish and English, and I am available at weekends and in the evenings. I think I am the right person for this job because I am fast and friendly. I would like to come to an interview next week.

Best regards,
Deniz Kaya

title: A Complaint Email
intro: Bu derste bir mağazaya arızalı ürün için şikâyet yazmayı, garanti ve fişten söz etmeyi ve kibarca para iadesi istemeyi çalışacaksın.

tasks.tr: Geçen hafta bir ceket aldım ama fermuarı çalışmıyor.
tasks.answer: I bought a jacket last week, but the zip doesn't work.
alternatives: I bought a jacket last week, but the zip does not work.
I bought a jacket last week, but the zipper doesn't work.
I bought a jacket last week, but the zipper does not work.
Last week I bought a jacket, but the zip doesn't work.
Last week I bought a jacket, but the zip does not work.
tasks.hint: Geniş zaman olumsuzunda ÜÇÜNCÜ TEKİL şahıs öznelerle (he, she, it, the zip) 'doesn't' kullanılır: the zip doesn't work.

tasks.tr: Ceket hâlâ garantide ve fiş hâlâ bende.
tasks.answer: It's still under warranty, and I still have the receipt.
alternatives: It is still under warranty, and I still have the receipt.
It's still under warranty and I still have the receipt.
It is still under warranty and I still have the receipt.
The jacket is still under warranty, and I still have the receipt.
The jacket is still under warranty and I still have the receipt.
tasks.hint: 'It is' kısaltması 'it's'; garanti kapsamında olmak için 'under warranty' denir.

tasks.tr: Onu iade etmek ve paramı geri almak istiyorum.
tasks.answer: I'd like to return it and get my money back.
alternatives: I would like to return it and get my money back.
I want to return it and get my money back.
I'd like to return it and get a refund.
I would like to return it and get a refund.
I want to return it and get a refund.
tasks.hint: Kibar istek için 'I'd like to' (= I would like to) kullanılır; ardından yalın fiil gelir: to return.

tasks.prompt: Bir mağazadan aldığın ürün arızalı çıktı. Mağazanın müşteri hizmetlerine kısa bir şikâyet e-postası yaz. Şu üçüne değin: (1) ne aldın ve ne zaman aldın, (2) üründeki sorun nedir, (3) ne istiyorsun (para iadesi mi, değişim mi) ve ne zamana kadar cevap bekliyorsun. Garantiden ve fişten de söz et.
checklist: Ne aldığımı ve ne zaman aldığımı yazdım mı?
Sorunu açıkça anlattım mı (ne çalışmıyor, ne bozuk)?
Garanti ve fiş konusuna değindim mi?
Ne istediğimi ve ne zamana kadar cevap beklediğimi söyledim mi?

phrases.de: I hope to hear from you soon.

tasks.sample:
Dear Customer Service,

I am writing about a jacket. I bought it in your shop on 12 March. The problem is that the zip doesn't work, and there is also a small hole in the left pocket. I have never worn the jacket outside.

The jacket is still under warranty, and I still have the receipt. I would like a refund, or a new jacket in the same size. Please reply by the end of this week.

I hope to hear from you soon.

Best regards,
Elif Demir

title: A Postcard from Rome
intro: Bu egzersizde gezideyken yazılan bir kartpostalı çalışacaksın: nereye vardığını, neler yaptığını ve yarın ne yapacağını anlatmayı.

tasks.answer: We arrived in Rome last Saturday.
alternatives: Last Saturday we arrived in Rome.
We arrived in Rome last Saturday
We got to Rome last Saturday.
tasks.hint: Bir şehre varmak için 'arrive in' kullanılır; geçmiş hâli 'arrived'.

tasks.tr: Hava harikaydı ve her gün şehirde yürüdük.
tasks.answer: The weather was great and we walked around the city every day.
alternatives: The weather was great and we walked around the city every day
The weather was great, and we walked around the city every day.
The weather was wonderful and we walked around the city every day.
tasks.hint: 'swim' düzensiz bir fiildir; geçmiş hâli 'swam' olur.

tasks.answer: We're going to visit the old town tomorrow.
alternatives: We are going to visit the old town tomorrow.
We will visit the old town tomorrow.
We'll visit the old town tomorrow.
Tomorrow we are going to visit the old town.
Tomorrow we're going to visit the old town.
tasks.hint: Önceden planlanmış işler için 'be going to' kullanılır: We're going to visit.

tasks.prompt: Tatildesin ve bir arkadaşına kartpostal yazıyorsun. Şu üçüne değin: (1) neredesin ve oraya ne zaman vardın, (2) şimdiye kadar neler yaptın ve orayı nasıl buldun, (3) dönmeden önce ne yapacaksın. Kısa bir selamlama ile başla, kapanış ve isminle bitir.
checklist: Nerede olduğunu ve oraya ne zaman vardığını yazdın mı?
Yaptığın en az iki şeyi geçmiş zamanla anlattın mı?
Orayı nasıl bulduğunu bir sıfatla söyledin mi (great, crowded, beautiful)?
Yarın veya dönmeden önce ne yapacağını 'going to' ya da 'will' ile yazdın mı?
tasks.sample: Hi Elif! Greetings from Rome! We arrived here last Saturday and the weather has been great. Yesterday we visited the old town and had pizza in a small restaurant. The streets were very crowded, but I loved them. This morning I bought a small souvenir for you. Tomorrow we're going to see the big museum, and on Sunday we will fly home. This is the best trip of my life. See you soon! Love, Deniz

title: Birthday Invitation
intro: Bu derste bir doğum günü davetini yazmayı ve bir davete kısa notla cevap vermeyi çalışacaksın.

tasks.tr: Cumartesi akşamı doğum günü partisi veriyorum.
tasks.answer: I'm having a birthday party on Saturday evening.
alternatives: I am having a birthday party on Saturday evening.
I am having a birthday party on Saturday evening
I'm having a birthday party on Saturday evening
tasks.hint: Planlanmış bir gelecek için present continuous kullanılır: I'm having …; gün adının önüne 'on' gelir.

tasks.answer: Thanks for the invitation, I'll definitely come.
alternatives: Thanks for the invitation, I will definitely come.
Thank you for the invitation, I will definitely come.
Thank you for the invitation, I'll definitely come.
tasks.hint: Teşekkür ederken 'thanks for' + isim gelir; kesin karar için 'will' kullanılır.

tasks.tr: Üzgünüm, gelemem çünkü o gün çalışıyorum.
tasks.answer: I'm sorry, I can't come because I'm working that day.
alternatives: I am sorry, I cannot come because I am working that day.
I am sorry, I can't come because I am working that day.
I'm sorry, I can't come because I am working that day.
I'm sorry, I cannot come because I'm working that day.
I am sorry, I can't come because I'm working that day.
I am sorry, I cannot come because I'm working that day.
I'm sorry, I cannot come because I am working that day.
tasks.hint: Bir daveti reddederken önce 'I'm sorry' de, sonra sebebi 'because' ile ekle.

tasks.prompt: Arkadaşına doğum günü partin için kısa bir davet mesajı yaz. Şu üçüne değin: (1) partinin günü, saati ve yeri; (2) partide birlikte ne yapacağınız; (3) arkadaşından ne istediğin (bir şey getirmesi ya da sana cevap vermesi).
checklist: Gün, saat ve yeri açıkça yazdın mı?
Partide ne yapacağınızı anlattın mı?
Arkadaşından bir şey getirmesini ya da cevap vermesini istedin mi?
Bir selamlama ve bir kapanış cümlesi var mı?

phrases.de: I'm having a birthday party on …
We're going to eat and listen to music.
Can you tell me before Friday?
phrases.tr: Cumadan önce bana haber verebilir misin?

tasks.sample: Hi Deniz! I'm having a birthday party on Saturday evening. It starts at seven o'clock at my house. My sister will make a big cake and we're going to eat pizza, listen to music and dance a little. Please bring your brother too, but don't bring a present. Can you tell me before Friday? I hope you can come. See you soon!

title: An Email to the City Office
intro: Belediyeden randevu isteyip hangi belgeleri getirmen gerektiğini sorarken kullanılan resmî e-posta dilini çalışacaksın.

tasks.tr: Gelecek hafta için bir randevu almak istiyorum.
tasks.answer: I would like to make an appointment for next week.
alternatives: I'd like to make an appointment for next week.
I would like to book an appointment for next week.
I'd like to book an appointment for next week.
tasks.hint: Resmî yazışmada 'I want' yerine kibar olan 'I would like' kullanılır; kısaltması 'I'd like'.

tasks.answer: I don't know which documents I have to bring.
alternatives: I do not know which documents I have to bring.
I don't know which documents I must bring.
I do not know which documents I must bring.
I don't know which documents I need to bring.
I do not know which documents I need to bring.
I don't know which documents I've to bring.
I do not know which documents I've to bring.
tasks.hint: Zorunluluk için 'have to' ya da 'must' kullanılır; 'do not know' kısaltması 'don't know'.

tasks.tr: Ne yazık ki cuma günü ofise gelemem.
tasks.answer: Unfortunately, I can't come to the office on Friday.
alternatives: Unfortunately, I cannot come to the office on Friday.
Unfortunately I can't come to the office on Friday.
Unfortunately I cannot come to the office on Friday.
tasks.hint: Günlerden önce 'on' gelir: on Friday; 'cannot' resmî hâli, 'can't' kısaltmasıdır.

tasks.prompt: Belediyeye resmî bir e-posta yaz: yeni adresini kaydettirmek için randevu iste. Şu üçüne değin: (1) kim olduğun ve neden randevu istediğin, (2) hangi gün ve saatlerde gelebileceğin, (3) yanına hangi belgeleri getirmen gerektiğini sorman. Resmî selamlama ve kapanışla bitir.
checklist: Resmî bir selamlama ve kapanış cümlesi kullandın mı?
Randevuyu neden istediğini açıkça yazdın mı?
Hangi gün ve saatte gelebileceğini belirttin mi?
Belgeleri sorarken 'have to' veya 'must' kullandın mı?

phrases.de: I would like to make an appointment.
I have just moved to this city.
I can come on Tuesday morning.
Could you tell me which documents I have to bring?
phrases.tr: Hangi belgeleri getirmem gerektiğini söyleyebilir misiniz?

phrases.de: I look forward to your reply.

tasks.sample:
Dear Sir or Madam,

My name is Elif Yilmaz and I have just moved to your city. I would like to make an appointment at your office to register my new address. I can come on Tuesday or Wednesday morning, but unfortunately I can't come on Friday. Could you also tell me which documents I have to bring? I don't know if my ID card is enough. Thank you very much for your help. I look forward to your reply.

Kind regards,
Elif Yilmaz

title: School Trip to the Zoo
intro: Öğretmenin velilere gönderdiği kısa mektubu oku: gezi ne zaman, kaç para, çocuk yanında ne getirecek.
text:
Dear parents,

On Friday, May 10, class 3B goes to the city zoo. We meet at school at half past eight and come back at three o'clock.

The trip costs five euros. Please give the money to the teacher on Monday.

Your child needs a small bag, lunch, water and good shoes. The zoo is big and we walk a lot!

Phones stay at home. Cameras are okay.

Thank you,
Ms. Carter

questions.text: What is the letter about?
options: a birthday party at the zoo
questions.explain: İlk cümle „class 3B goes to the city zoo“ — sınıf geziye gidiyor; öğretmen ya da parti anlatılmıyor.

questions.text: When does the class come back?
questions.explain: „…and come back at three o'clock.“ Sekiz buçuk buluşma saati, pazartesi paranın günü.

questions.text: The children can bring their phones.
questions.explain: „Phones stay at home.“ — telefonlar evde kalıyor; fotoğraf makinesi serbest.

questions.text: The trip costs ___ euros.
questions.explain: „The trip costs five euros.“

questions.text: What day is the trip?
questions.explain: „On Friday, May 10 …“ — gezi cuma günü.

questions.text: What does a child need for the trip?
questions.explain: „Your child needs a small bag, lunch, water and good shoes.“ Para öğretmene pazartesi veriliyor.

title: Lost Property at the Bus Station
intro: Nadia otobüste çantasını unutmuş; kayıp eşya bürosundaki görevliyle konuşmasını dinle.

segments.speaker: Officer
segments.text: Hello. Can I help you?

segments.speaker: Nadia
segments.text: Yes, please. I lost my bag on the bus this morning.

segments.speaker: Officer
segments.text: Okay. Which bus?

segments.speaker: Nadia
segments.text: Bus number twenty-two, at about nine o'clock.

segments.speaker: Officer
segments.text: What color is the bag?

segments.speaker: Nadia
segments.text: It's black, with a small red flower on it.

segments.speaker: Officer
segments.text: And what is in the bag?

segments.speaker: Nadia
segments.text: My phone, my keys and a book.

segments.speaker: Officer
segments.text: Is there a name in the bag?

segments.speaker: Nadia
segments.text: No, but the book is from the city library. My name is on the library card.

segments.speaker: Officer
segments.text: Good. What's your name and phone number?

segments.speaker: Nadia
segments.text: Nadia Sarkis. Zero seven seven, one two three, four five six.

segments.speaker: Officer
segments.text: Thank you, Nadia. We call you when we find the bag.

segments.speaker: Nadia
segments.text: Great, thank you very much!

questions.text: Where did Nadia lose her bag?
questions.explain: „I lost my bag on the bus this morning.“ Büro istasyonda ama çanta otobüste kaldı.

questions.text: What does the bag look like?
questions.explain: „It's black, with a small red flower on it.“ Küçük olan çanta değil, çiçek.

questions.text: Nadia's name is in the bag.
questions.explain: „Is there a name in the bag?“ — „No, but … my name is on the library card.“ Ad kartta, çantada değil.

questions.text: What number is the bus?
questions.explain: „Bus number twenty-two, at about nine o'clock.“

questions.text: Görevlinin renk sorusunu duyduğun gibi yaz.
questions.explain: „What color is the bag?“ — soru kelimesi + is + özne.

questions.text: What does the officer do at the end?
options: He gives Nadia a new bag.
He sends Nadia to the library.
He calls Nadia when they find the bag.
questions.explain: „We call you when we find the bag.“

title: A Card for Grandma
intro: Ninenin doğum günü; önce iki cümle kur, sonra ona kısa bir kart yaz.

alternatives: Happy birthday Grandma!
tasks.hint: Kutlama kalıbı „Happy birthday“ + virgül + kişi; Türkçedeki gibi „olsun“ fiili yok.

tasks.answer: We are visiting you on Sunday.
alternatives: On Sunday we are visiting you.
We visit you on Sunday.
tasks.hint: Kesin bir plan için „be + -ing“: We are visiting. Gün adından önce „on“ gelir.

tasks.prompt: Ninenin doğum günü. Kart yaz: kutla, onun sevdiğin bir yanını söyle, hediyeni yaz, ne zaman ziyaret edeceğini söyle ve imzala.
checklist: Doğum gününü kutla
Sevdiğin bir yanını söyle
Hediyeni yaz
Ziyaret gününü söyle ve imzala
tasks.sample: Dear Grandma, happy birthday! I hope you have a great day. You are the best cook in the family and I love your cake. Your present is a new book about gardens. We are visiting you on Sunday at four o'clock. See you soon! Lots of love, Deniz

title: th: think and this
intro: Türkçede olmayan „th“ sesi: dilin ucu dişlerin arasında. Yedi cümlede t, s ve d'ye kaçmadan söyle.

tasks.hint: „th“: dilin ucunu üst dişlerine değdir ve hava üfle. t değil, s değil.

confusions.fix: Dilin ucu dişlerin arasında, sessiz üfleme: „thank“. „tank“ ve „sank“ başka kelimeler.

tasks.de: I think this is my bag.
tasks.hint: „think“ sessiz th (üfleme), „this“ sesli th (titreşimli). İkisinde de dil dişlerin arasında.

confusions.fix: „think“te t ya da s değil, dişler arasından üfle; „this“te aynı yerde titreşim.

tasks.hint: „thirty-three“: iki kez sessiz th. „brother“ ortasındaki th sesli.

confusions.fix: Her iki th'de dil dişlerin arasında; „tree“ (ağaç) ve „free“ (bedava) başka kelimeler.

tasks.de: The weather is good on Thursday.
tasks.hint: „the“ ve „weather“: sesli th. „Thursday“: sessiz th.

confusions.fix: „the“ d ile değil, dişler arasında titreşimle. „Thursday“ Tuesday ile karışmasın: th üfle.

tasks.hint: „third“ = sessiz th + kısa ı sesi; r duyulmasa da olur.

confusions.fix: „third“ baştaki th üflemeli; t ile söylersen kaba bir kelime çıkar.

tasks.hint: „both“ sonu sessiz th; „them“ başı sesli th.

confusions.fix: „both“ kelime sonunda dişler arasından üfle; „boat“ (tekne) olmasın.

tasks.de: I have three brothers and a mother.
tasks.tr: Üç erkek kardeşim ve bir annem var.
tasks.hint: „three“ sessiz th; „brothers“ ve „mother“ sesli th.

confusions.fix: „three“ t ya da f değil, üflemeli th. „mother“ d ile değil, titreşimli th.

title: do or does?
intro: Alışkanlıkları anlatırken fiilin ne zaman -s aldığını ve soruda do/does'ın nasıl çalıştığını öğren.
focus: Present simple: do / does ve üçüncü tekilde -s

explanation.heading: Ne zaman kullanılır?
explanation.tr: Alışkanlık, rutin ve genel doğrular için: her sabah kahve içmek, bir şehirde yaşamak. Türkçede -r/-ir eki ne yapıyorsa (içerim, yaşarım) present simple onu yapar.

examples.de: I drink coffee every morning.
She lives in Berlin.
They work at a bank.

explanation.heading: Üçüncü tekilde -s
explanation.tr: he / she / it ile fiil -s alır: work → works, live → lives. Sonu -o, -sh, -ch ile bitenlerde -es: goes, watches. „have“ düzensiz: has.

examples.de: He works in a shop.
She watches TV in the evening.
My brother has a dog.

explanation.heading: Soru ve olumsuz: do / does
explanation.tr: Soruda ve olumsuzda yardımcı fiil do/does gelir ve -s yardımcıya geçer: Does she work? — She doesn't work. Asıl fiil yalın kalır, -s almaz.

examples.de: Do you like tea?
Does he speak English?
We don't eat fish.

questions.text: She ___ in Izmir.
questions.explain: „she“ üçüncü tekil: live → lives. „is live“ diye bir biçim yok.

questions.text: ___ you like coffee?
questions.explain: „you“ ile yardımcı fiil „do“; „does“ yalnız he/she/it ile.

questions.text: He ___ tennis on Saturday.
questions.explain: „he“ ile -s: plays. Rutin için -ing biçimi kullanılmaz.

questions.text: My mother ___ (work) at a school.
questions.explain: „my mother“ = she → works.

questions.text: ___ your brother speak English? (do / does)
questions.explain: „your brother“ = he → Does. Asıl fiil yalın: speak.

questions.text: They ___ (not / drink) tea.
questions.explain: Olumsuz: do + not + yalın fiil → don't drink.

questions.text: Soruyu doğru sıraya diz.
questions.explain: Soruda sıra: Does + özne + yalın fiil: Does she live here?

questions.text: „He don't like pizza.“ — Bu cümle doğru mu?
questions.explain: „he“ ile olumsuz „doesn't“: He doesn't like pizza.

questions.text: „We go to school by bus.“ — Bu cümle doğru mu?
questions.explain: „we“ ile fiil yalın kalır: go. Cümle doğru.

questions.text: Ali ___ TV in the evening.
questions.explain: Sonu -ch ile biten fiil üçüncü tekilde -es alır: watches.

title: My First Month at the Shelter
intro: Hayvan barınağında gönüllü olan birinin ilk ayını anlattığı blog yazısını okuyacaksın.
text:
MY FIRST MONTH AT THE SHELTER

Four weeks ago I started as a volunteer at the animal shelter near my flat. I go there every Saturday morning for three hours.

On my first day I was nervous. Marta, who has worked there for nine years, showed me everything: where the food is, how much water each bowl needs, and which dogs you can walk alone.

The work is not romantic. I clean cages, I wash blankets and I carry heavy bags. But then there is the other part. Two weeks ago I walked a small brown dog called Rocky. He was scared of everything - cars, bikes, even plastic bags. Last Saturday a bus stopped next to us and he did not run away. That felt better than any thank-you.

Two dogs found a new owner last month. One of them was Rocky's friend, so now Rocky is alone again. I know this is good news, but I was sad for a day.

If you have three free hours a week, go and ask them. They always need people.

questions.text: What is the text about?
options: The writer's first weeks as a volunteer.
How to choose a dog for your family.
A shelter that will close next month.
questions.explain: Başlık ve ilk cümle bunu söylüyor: dört hafta önce gönüllü olarak başladı. Kapanma ya da köpek seçme hiç geçmiyor.
